dedupe_keys.name: canada s core infrastructure cost dataset estimated replacement costs of roads and non linear wastewater assets by location

description: Canada's Core Infrastructure Cost Dataset, published by Housing, Infrastructure and Communities Canada, assigns estimated replacement costs to public infrastructure assets across the country by location and asset type. The dataset page read on 2026-09-28 explains that costs are derived from the replacement cost and inventory count estimates of Canada's Core Public Infrastructure (CCPI) survey combined with public national location data, that the map and database are planned to cover roads, wastewater and drinking water facilities, recreation and sports facilities and transit facilities, and that the completed layers so far are roads and non-linear wastewater facilities, offered as ZIP files in English and French with a methodology report of October 2025; Quebec is not included. Coverage is Canada except Quebec. Access is free under the Open Government Licence - Canada. Caveats: costs are modelled averages allocated to locations, not asset book values, and several asset classes are still to come. It supports exposure values for hazard loss and resilience studies of Canadian roads and wastewater plants. Related records: data-statcan-canada-core-public-infrastructure-survey is the source survey, and data-canada-national-road-network-nrn gives the road geometry.
